local function sha256(message)
 local band,bxor,bnot,rshift,ror=bit32.band,bit32.bxor,bit32.bnot,bit32.rshift,bit32.rrotate
 local k={0x428a2f98,0x71374491,0xb5c0fbcf,0xe9b5dba5,0x3956c25b,0x59f111f1,0x923f82a4,0xab1c5ed5,0xd807aa98,0x12835b01,0x243185be,0x550c7dc3,0x72be5d74,0x80deb1fe,0x9bdc06a7,0xc19bf174,0xe49b69c1,0xefbe4786,0x0fc19dc6,0x240ca1cc,0x2de92c6f,0x4a7484aa,0x5cb0a9dc,0x76f988da,0x983e5152,0xa831c66d,0xb00327c8,0xbf597fc7,0xc6e00bf3,0xd5a79147,0x06ca6351,0x14292967,0x27b70a85,0x2e1b2138,0x4d2c6dfc,0x53380d13,0x650a7354,0x766a0abb,0x81c2c92e,0x92722c85,0xa2bfe8a1,0xa81a664b,0xc24b8b70,0xc76c51a3,0xd192e819,0xd6990624,0xf40e3585,0x106aa070,0x19a4c116,0x1e376c08,0x2748774c,0x34b0bcb5,0x391c0cb3,0x4ed8aa4a,0x5b9cca4f,0x682e6ff3,0x748f82ee,0x78a5636f,0x84c87814,0x8cc70208,0x90befffa,0xa4506ceb,0xbef9a3f7,0xc67178f2}
 local h={0x6a09e667,0xbb67ae85,0x3c6ef372,0xa54ff53a,0x510e527f,0x9b05688c,0x1f83d9ab,0x5be0cd19}
 local function bytes(n) return string.char(band(rshift(n,24),255),band(rshift(n,16),255),band(rshift(n,8),255),band(n,255)) end
 local length=#message
 message=message..'\128'..string.rep('\0',(55-length)%64)..bytes(math.floor(length/536870912))..bytes((length*8)%4294967296)
 local w={}
 for offset=1,#message,64 do
  for i=0,15 do local a,b,c,d=message:byte(offset+i*4,offset+i*4+3);w[i]=((a*256+b)*256+c)*256+d end
  for i=16,63 do local x,y=w[i-15],w[i-2];w[i]=(w[i-16]+bxor(ror(x,7),ror(x,18),rshift(x,3))+w[i-7]+bxor(ror(y,17),ror(y,19),rshift(y,10)))%4294967296 end
  local a,b,c,d,e,f,g,j=table.unpack(h)
  for i=0,63 do
   local t1=(j+bxor(ror(e,6),ror(e,11),ror(e,25))+bxor(band(e,f),band(bnot(e),g))+k[i+1]+w[i])%4294967296
   local t2=(bxor(ror(a,2),ror(a,13),ror(a,22))+bxor(band(a,b),band(a,c),band(b,c)))%4294967296
   j,g,f,e,d,c,b,a=g,f,e,(d+t1)%4294967296,c,b,a,(t1+t2)%4294967296
  end
  for i,v in ipairs({a,b,c,d,e,f,g,j}) do h[i]=(h[i]+v)%4294967296 end
  if offset%65536==1 and task then task.wait() end
 end
 local out={};for i,v in ipairs(h) do out[i]=string.format('%08x',v) end
 return table.concat(out)
end

local function report(message)
 warn('[bvc] '..message)
end

   key=(key*73+41)%256
   value=bit32.bxor(value,key)

   chars[#chars+1]=string.char(value)
  end

  if index%16==0 then task.wait() end
 end
 assert(total==1292854 and b*65536+a==2028310178,'Integrity check failed. Use a fresh copy of the file.')
 local body=table.concat(decoded)
 assert(sha256(body)=='682033658c43e1ec6508658ba3b8e6bb2a6e05d4ad1a080a5519737c70d9b952','SHA-256 integrity check failed')
 local start,compileError=loadstring(body,'bvc')

end)
